dedupe_keys.name: 180 bus medium voltage distribution network data

description: Fabio Castro at the Polytechnic Institute of Porto publishes a realistic medium-voltage distribution-network case with 180 electrical buses and ninety loads representing 6,799 consumers. The metadata enumerate five EV parking lots, two storage systems, forty-two wind farms, thirty-three PV parks, three biomass units and one substation. Cable resistance, reactance and thermal limits accompany demand, EV-demand and renewable-generation profiles for sixty-four scenarios. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook released in December 2023, free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage, scenario dates and sampling interval remain unknown from the description. This case supports power-flow, hosting-capacity and network-planning simulations. Equipment ratings and scenario scaling were not checked against the workbook. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The earlier transport-only rejection confused electrical buses with transport resources.
